fields.name: container
fields.description: Where to render the toolbar: an element, an id selector (`#toolbar`), a class selector (`.toolbar`), or a bare element id. Other CSS selector syntax resolves to nothing.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Built-in controls to render by region. Controls keep their built-in order. Omit to use the default toolbar.

fields.name: excludeItems
fields.description: Controls to remove. Also accepts the id of a custom item.

fields.name: icons
fields.description: Trusted inline SVG overrides keyed by public icon id.

fields.name: strings
fields.description: Text overrides keyed by public string id.

fields.name: overflow
fields.description: How the toolbar handles controls that no longer fit (default: `'menu'`).

fields.name: responsiveTo
fields.description: Width source used to lay out the toolbar (default: `'viewport'`).

fields.name: fontOptions
fields.description: Options shown in the font-family dropdown. Register loadable fonts through `fonts.families`.

fields.name: customItems
fields.description: Application-defined controls and separators to add.

fields.name: includeItems
fields.description: Additional opt-in controls. With `items`, each uses its built-in region unless already listed.
